goal: Catch struct padding regressions automatically to prevent memory bloat in long-lived data structures
Reduce wasted RAM by reordering member variables across core networking, mempool, and validation classes
reviewability: CI is failing, check whether the failure is caused by this PR before a deep review
agreement: Concept approval to catch memory regressions with automated checks (hodlinator, bartoli, jonatack, sedited)
Unaddressed objection: reordering fields harms readability by splitting fields that belong together (maflcko)
Unaddressed objection: splitting rolling mempool fields harms readability for no benefit (maflcko)
Prefers evaluating structs case-by-case or opt-in rather than enabling a global check (maflcko, l0rinc)

why: P3 because adding an optional static analysis check guards against future struct padding regressions
It does not address release integrity, platform breakages, or CI reliability
